name: Fresh Beef Tenderloin / Filet Mignon (Center Cut, Seared)
whyItWorks: The psoas major muscle is non-weight-bearing, making it the most tender cut of beef on the entire animal. Contains minimal tough gristle or connective collagen; pan-seared medium-rare, it melts upon chewing and supplies vital heme iron.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Sear in a cast-iron skillet with 1 tsp olive oil or ghee for 3–4 minutes per side. Let rest for 5 minutes before slicing thin.
